items.title: Wall Street Just Called the Fed’s October Hold a Mistake. Here’s Warren Buffett’s 9-Word Rule From the Last Time the Fed Doubled Rates, and What It Does for $1 Million in an Index Fund
items.summary: Bank of America calls the Fed's October hold a policy mistake, Goldman adds a March hike and Governor Waller has put a half point on the table for December. The last four times the Fed tightened under that accusation (1937, 1994, 2018, 2022) the S&P 500 split two and two a year later. Warren Buffett's nine-word rule from his 1994 letter, and what it does for a retired couple with $1 million in an index fund and $200,000 in cash.
